name: Future Lens
summary:
Step into spatial stories with Future Lens. Explore published spaces in virtual reality, discover panoramic scenes, and experience digital objects alongside your surroundings in mixed reality.

For creators, Future Lens brings spatial editing into the headset. Use your existing Future Lens account to open your spaces, arrange 3D objects, and compose experiences with images, video, narration, and interactive story steps.

Explore together in supported shared spaces, with optional voice chat and collaborative
